review:
Mighty Wild: Gorilla is built around Collector symbols. They stay active for up to 10 spins, gathering every Cash and Jackpot value that lands on the reels beneath them, and multipliers from x2 to x10 can boost what they collect. Random Cash Out symbols pay out the Collector's total on the spot.

There are two bonuses. Free Spins gives 10 spins where Collectors never disappear, extended by Countdown Boosters and kept alive by Collect to Infinity. Hold the Jackpot is a 16-reel round with three respins and a 2,500x Grand Jackpot. Wazdan rates it very high volatility with a 96.2% RTP, and Chance Level offers x2, x5 or x10 bets for better bonus odds.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
